name: USD/JPY 2Y Rate Differential Mean Reversion
description: Mean-reversion strategy on USD/JPY using the 2-year interest rate differential OLS fair value model. Engle-Granger cointegration (window=2520) estimates the fair value relationship between USD/JPY and the US-Japan 2Y yield spread. The deviation from fair value is z-scored (252-day window). Long entry when z-score crosses below -1.5 (undervalued), exit when z-score crosses above 0. Short entry when z-score crosses above +1.5 (overvalued), exit when z-score crosses below 0. Position sizing: 100% of equity.
source:
# USD/JPY 2Y Rate Differential Mean Reversion Strategy
# Fair value model: OLS regression of USD/JPY on US-Japan 2Y yield spread
# Signal: z-score of deviation from fair value
# Long when z < -1.5 (undervalued), exit at z > 0
# Short when z > +1.5 (overvalued), exit at z < 0

# --- Data Sources ---
src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c

# US 2-Year Treasury Yield (daily, use FRED not ALFRED)
us_2y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="DGS2", use_alfred=False)()
yield_us_2y = ffill(us_2y_raw.result)

# Japan 2-Year Government Bond Yield proxy (monthly, use FRED not ALFRED)
jp_2y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="INTGSTJPM193N", use_alfred=False)()
yield_jp_2y = ffill(jp_2y_raw.result)

# 2Y Interest Rate Differential
diff_2y = yield_us_2y - yield_jp_2y

# --- Fair Value Model ---
# Engle-Granger cointegration: USD/JPY = alpha + beta * diff_2y
eg_2y = engle_granger(window=2520)(close_fx, diff_2y)

# OLS fair value and deviation
fair_value_2y = eg_2y.intercept + eg_2y.hedge_ratio * diff_2y
deviation_2y = close_fx - fair_value_2y

# Z-score of deviation (252-day rolling window)
zscore_2y = zscore(window=252)(deviation_2y)

# --- Signal Logic ---
# Long entry: z-score crosses below -1.5 (USD/JPY undervalued)
long_entry_pulse = crossunder(zscore_2y, -1.5)
# Long exit: z-score crosses above 0 (reverted to fair value)
long_exit_pulse = crossover(zscore_2y, 0)

# Short entry: z-score crosses above +1.5 (USD/JPY overvalued)
short_entry_pulse = crossover(zscore_2y, 1.5)
# Short exit: z-score crosses below 0 (reverted to fair value)
short_exit_pulse = crossunder(zscore_2y, 0)

# Hold signals from entry pulse until exit pulse
long_state = hold_until()(enter=long_entry_pulse, exit=long_exit_pulse)
short_state = hold_until()(enter=short_entry_pulse, exit=short_exit_pulse)

# --- Execution ---
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_state, short_entry=short_state)

# 100% of equity per position
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)
